paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18, with a change of -0.16% from the prior close and -16.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 7, 2026.

Recent news headlines include discussions of the company's CEO departure, expected agreements with tenants, and retail positioning. A filing with the SEC announced the departure of CEO Toby Neugebauer as of April 17, 2026, and the establishment of an Interim Office of the CEO. The company also expects to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year.

There have been 25 total filings, including 1 Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Cetera Investment Advisers also lifted its holdings in shares of Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing.
